experience.title: Academic Tutor
bullets: Tutored students in math and study planning, noticing missed deadlines often came from disorganized schedules, not the material.
Began sketching a simple app to help students track deadlines, motivating a shift toward computer science coursework.

projects.title: My Assistant App
bullets: Built an Android app in Kotlin to help students track timetables, deadlines and test dates.
Structured the app across 213 files using Android navigation components.

projects.title: My Finance App
bullets: Built a first cross-platform Flutter app for tracking personal income and expenses, sharing Dart code across platforms.
Documented the setup process as a learning log while picking up Flutter for the first time.

leadership.title: Mentor and Notes Writer
bullets: Started writing short Kotlin setup guides after newer members struggled with the same Android Studio steps.
Found explaining mobile development concepts to beginners more energizing than solo building.
